title: Sardinha defumada na lata
creator: olhaqloko

items.note: can in oil (it doesn't work with sardines in water or tomato sauce)

steps: Open a can of sardines in oil and lay a folded paper towel over the sardines, leaving some sticking out on all sides.
On a clear, non-flammable surface, carefully set light to the edges of the paper. When the flames reach the oil, the sardines start to smoke.
Let it smoke for about 5 minutes, then blow out the flame or lift the paper off with tongs.
Eat as is, or on buttered bread with garlic farofa and a squeeze of lemon.
